name: Metal Gear Mk. II
source:
A "navigator" robot who serves as an on-site forensic analyzer and has a built-in videophone. His designer Harry Benson claims that he designed Metal after the "Metal Gear threat from the late 20th century".

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snatcher_%28video_game%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
